name: NPN transistor (2N2222)
description: A small NPN transistor used as an electronic switch or amplifier: a small current into the base (B) lets a current up to about 100 times bigger flow from the collector (C) to the emitter (E). Connect E to GND, feed B from an Arduino pin through a 1kΩ resistor, and put the load (LED, buzzer, relay) between the supply and C. Conducts when B is about 0.65 V above E; fully on (saturated) it drops about 0.2 V.
